(Lodged In Central Jail, Sri Ganganagar)
 ----Appellant  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2.
Balveer Kaur W/o Bhagwan Singh, R/o 59F, Gajsinghpur  Dist Sri Ganganagar.
----Respondents For Appellant(s) : Mr. Birbal Ram Bishnoi For Respondent(s) : Mr. Lalit Kishor Sen, PP  Mr. Baltej Singh Sandhu for  respondent No.2
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI Order 09/10/2024 1.

Instant Criminal appeal has been preferred to enlarge the appellant on bail under Section 14A(2)
of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and being aggrieved of the order dated 01.04.2024 passed by learned Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocity Cases), Sri Ganganagar in Criminal Misc. Case No.184/2024 rejecting the bail application preferred on behalf of the appellant who is in custody in connection with FIR No.30/2024, Police Station Gajsinghpur, District Sri Ganganagar,
for offences under Sections 447, 354 and 376/511 IPC and Section 3(2)(va) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

entities.text: Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocity Cases), Sri Ganganagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Notice of the appeal has been served upon the respondent No.2.

entities.text: Madan Lal vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:41469)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I have given my thoughtful consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and have perused the record carefully.

4. Having regard to the facts of the case and taking into account totality of circumstances, in my considered opinion, the submissions made by learned counsel for the appellant cannot be completely overlooked.
In the present case it is prima facie seen that allegation against the appellant is of outraging modesty of victim and attempt to commit rape with her in an open field besides a public road.
Charge-sheet in the matter has already been filed.
The appellant is in custody since 12.03.2024; that the trial is likely to take its own considerable time and no useful purpose would be served by keeping him in detention for an indefinite period.

In that view of the matter, this Court is of the opinion that the appellant deserves indulgence of bail and thus, the order rejecting the application for bail filed on behalf of the appellant cannot be sustained.
5. Consequently, the appeal is allowed.

The order dated 01.04.2024 is set aside and it is ordered that the accused- appellant Madan Lal S/o Het Ram arrested in connection with FIR No.30/2024, Police Station Gajsinghpur, District Sri Ganganagar shall be released on bail during pendency of the trial;
provided he furnishes personal bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- and two surety bonds of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so and if not required by Jail Authorities in any other case.

This order is subject [2024:RJ-JD:41469] (3 of 3) [CRLAS-587/2024] to the condition that accused, within 7 days of his release and sureties, on the day of furnishing bail, will also furnish details of their all bank accounts, with bank and branch name, in shape of an affidavit, and submit legible copy of their Aadhar cards as well as front page of Bank pass book, for smooth recovery of penalty amount, if there arise a need for recovery of penalty under Section 446 Cr.P.C in future.
(RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI),J 184-Payal/-
